messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] 1776543210 - Rapid increase in 5xx and streaming disconnects in region eu-west-1. Affected routes: /v1/chat/stream, /v1/generate-stream. Symptoms: 502 responses from edge, intermittent HTTP/2 RST_STREAM, client-side cancellations. Estimated 9-14% error delta vs baseline. Paging @luca (oncall).
luca (oncall): Acknowledged. Jumping in. Sam/Hana/Rafael, please triage. Nina, start collecting affected customer session IDs.
sam (SRE): Checking control plane: no deploys in last 90m per deploy-bot. Pulling envoy logs now and grepping for RST_STREAM/timeout. `kubectl -n gateway logs -l app=gateway -c envoy --since=30m | egrep "RST_STREAM|upstream reset|timeout|502"`
hana (runtime): From runtime side, there were several long-lived streams around 16:18Z. Tailing runtime proxy: `journalctl -u runtime-proxy -f --since "20 minutes ago" | grep -iE "write failed|broken pipe|EPIPE|chunk"`. Seeing multiple write errors when sending 16k+ chunks.
rafael (eng-platform): Looking at LB and nginx fronting. Noting an increase in upstream 502s coincident with a spike in SYN/FIN pairs in netmetrics. Might be handshake/idle drop issue. Gathering nginx error.log excerpts.
nina (support): Two enterprise customers reported session interruptions ~16:20Z. Asking them for examples; have session ids from logs: sess_8f3a1, sess_b7c22. They report reconnect loops and partial messages.
deply-bot: (typo) whoops message
deploy-bot: No customer-side deploys detected in window 2026-03-15 16:00-16:30.
sam (SRE): Found this pattern in envoy: `upstream reset: connection failure, remote closing` and `stream closed before end of response` around 16:19:07Z. Also seeing `HTTP/2: stream aborted by remote` entries. Suspect an intermediary (LB or client) closing during chunk flush.
luca (oncall): Immediate mitigations brainstorm: 1) reduce chunk size at runtime to <8k, 2) fallback to buffered responses (disable streaming chunked at edge), 3) bump keepalive in gateway and LB to avoid premature close, 4) shift portion of traffic to eu-central. Which is fastest?
hana (runtime): Fastest is to flip server-side chunking to smaller writes (runtime config) or enable a buffered streaming mode that accumulates until safe flush. I can change runtime chunk_size from 16384 -> 4096 for eu-west routes in the runtime config. That should be low-risk and hot-reloadable.
rafael (eng-platform): We can also patch nginx upstream `proxy_buffer_size` and `proxy_busy_buffers_size` but that requires rolling reloads. Bumping keepalive_timeout from 30s -> 120s on the LB is low-risk and reversible. I can request it to be applied.
luca (oncall): OK — Hana go ahead with chunk_size reduction. Rafael request LB keepalive bump and prepare a gradual traffic shift of 25% to eu-central. Nina prepare holding message. Sam collect correlated traces and mark postmortem owner.
hana (runtime): Patching runtime config for routes in eu-west now: 
```
PATCH /runtime/configs/eu-west
{ "streaming": { "chunk_size": 4096, "streaming_mode": "auto-buffer" } }
```
apply-> success (change-id: rt-20260315-09). Runtime reports config reload 16:24:12Z.
rafael (eng-platform): LB keepalive submitted to cloud vendor via portal and requested immediate optional change. Also starting a slow traffic reweight: 25% to eu-central over 8 minutes.
vendor-lb-bot: Support ticket LB-20260315-78 opened; vendor accepting packet capture request for window 16:15-16:30Z. ETA 45m.
sam (SRE): Metrics after runtime change: streaming 5xx rate reduced from ~11% -> 4.2% within 6 minutes. Client disconnects flagged by gateway dropped by ~60% in that window. Good sign.
nina (support): Sent holding note to affected customers: "We're aware of streaming disconnects in EU and applying mitigations (reducing chunk sizes and increasing keepalive). We'll provide a follow-up by 17:00Z." Customers acknowledged and asked to be added to follow-up.
luca (oncall): Keep mitigations for now. Hana keep the smaller chunk size until we have vendor traces and a root cause. Rafael keep traffic shift gradual. Sam start a timeline and gather envoy/runtime logs + k8s events for 16:00-16:40.
hana (runtime): Enabling extra debug sampling for chunk writes for next 4 hours: `LOG_CHUNK_DEBUG=1 ./runtime --sample=1/200` capturing write failures and chunk sizes.
sam (SRE): Correlating an interesting pattern: large chunk writes failing when upstream connection was re-used after idle >30s then closed by LB with FIN mid-response. Suggests keepalive/idle mismatch. Vendor packet traces will confirm.
luca (oncall): Good. If errors remain above 3% after 30m, escalate to incident channel and consider disabling streaming for impacted customers to avoid data loss.
rafael (eng-platform): Rolling config note: applied temporary nginx buffer increases and set `proxy_http_version 1.1` for affected upstreams to reduce HTTP/2 edge cases. Rolling restart of 3 nginx nodes done with no mass disconnects.
vendor-lb-bot: Packet capture uploaded to ticket LB-20260315-78. Vendor comments: "We observe abrupt RST segments from LB->backend around 16:19:xx when backend sends >12k frames after idle. Potentially MTU/fragmentation plus keepalive interplay."
sam (SRE): After LB keepalive applied and runtime chunk size lowered, error rate stabilized to ~2.1% and client-reported session drops subsided.
nina (support): Two enterprise customers confirmed improved behavior and will monitor. No new sev tickets in last 20 minutes.
luca (oncall): Next actions: 1) Keep chunk_size reduced and keepalive increased for 2-4 hours; 2) vendor follow-up to confirm root cause and recommended config; 3) postmortem owners: sam (SRE) + hana (runtime) + rafael (eng-platform); 4) customer follow-up at 17:00Z with full context.
sam (SRE): Filed incident: INC-20260315-euw-streaming-keepalive. Attached logs, traces, and packet captures. Starting timeline reconstruction.
hana (runtime): I'll instrument better runtime graceful-write handling and add fallback to buffered flush if a write returns EPIPE. Will prepare PR and review with rafael.
luca (oncall): Thanks all. For now: mitigated -> monitoring. If anything regresses ping me immediately. :white_check_mark:
nina (support): Sending consolidated customer update now.
deply-bot: cleaned up stray typo
